candidates.claim: Trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/24 on sw-it-01 allows VLAN 10 (OT), which is outside its approved VLAN set {30,99}.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 10 from the allowed VLAN list of trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/24 on sw-it-01 so it carries only VLANs 30 and 99.

candidates.claim: The trunk allowed-VLAN list on sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/24 was modified from the approved baseline [30,99] to [10,30,99].
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/24 trunk change against the approved baseline and either revert it or record it as an approved deviation.
